summary: Quiet residential kerb in the dip; houses 11-20 m away on both sides.
reasons: Gentle grade only at the low point

best_section.where: Gregory Street south kerb in the dip, west of the main-road corner

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11 m away on the section's own side, 19-20 m across the road; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a kerb lane; a few cars park nearby so room to pull in looks fine.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street, light traffic; busier main road at the east end.
drivers.convention: Odd cars parked along both kerbs, no sign of overnight camping.

flags: Steep: about 3% in the dip, 11% mean and 21.6% max over the full stretch
sun_shade: Mostly open; tree shade from the street trees at the west and east ends.
